verdicts.title: Tests of General Relativity with Binary Black Holes from the second LIGO-Virgo Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Gravitational waves enable tests of general relativity in the highly dynamical and strong-field regime.
